# CLI output is human-readable by default

## Context

The CLI is read directly by people and consumed programmatically by agents.
One command cannot serve both shapes at once without a switch.

## Decision

Every command prints human-readable text by default and emits structured JSON
only when `--json` is passed.

## Consequences

One output path stays authoritative for people, and every programmatic
consumer opts in explicitly, so a formatting change cannot silently break a
script.
